nodes.title: Guard-Dog Package Manifest
nodes.summary: NPM package configuration for guard-dog security scanner. Defines project metadata, executable entry points (guard-dog, guardog, guard-dog-scan), scripts for start/test/scan/setup/cron, and dependencies (dotenv, node-fetch). Requires Node.js 18+.
nodes.languageNotes: ESM module system. Defines bin entries for CLI commands: guard-dog (main CLI), guardog (alias), guard-dog-scan (dependency scanner). Scripts entry point includes test, scan, setup, and nightly cron job tasks.

nodes.title: Guard-Dog Documentation
nodes.summary: Internal documentation for guard-dog. Describes package-level security scanning for npm/pip packages, decision levels (BARK >= 100, WHINE 50-99, SILENT < 50), companion code-level review tool /gstack-cso, entry points for analyze and batch operations, and nightly scan cron schedule.
nodes.languageNotes: Entry points documented: 'node src/index.js analyze <package> [ecosystem] [url]' for single package, 'node src/index.js batch <packages.json>' for batch operations. Nightly cron runs via bin/cron-nightly-scan.sh.

nodes.title: Guardog Public Documentation
nodes.summary: User-facing README for guardog npm package. Covers installation via npm/GitHub, setup wizard (questions about nightly scans, pre-install hooks, git pre-commit, VirusTotal key), usage examples (analyze single packages, batch scans, doctor), nightly scan configuration, install hooks, VirusTotal integration, verdict definitions (SILENT/WHINE/BARK), and cross-platform support notes.

scanTypes: CVE-databases (OSV, GitHub Advisories, NVD, CISA KEV)

nodes.languageNotes: Emphasizes local-only operation: no OpenAI, no YOLO, no MyOS Dispatch, no Typeless. Uses public APIs (npm, PyPI, OSV, GitHub, NVD, VirusTotal). State folder: ~/.guardog (macOS/Linux) or %USERPROFILE%\.guardog (Windows).

nodes.title: Guardog Project Context
nodes.summary: Project overview for guard-dog/guardog. Public npm/PyPI package security scanner derived from internal guard-dog agent. Includes Claude Code /guardog skill, install.sh, git pre-commit hook, npm postinstall hook. No build step, Node.js ESM CLI only. Environment variables: VIRUSTOTAL_API_KEY (optional), TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN+CHAT_ID (optional), GITHUB_API_TOKEN (optional). State folder: ~/guardog/ for installations.

environmentVariables.VIRUSTOTAL_API_KEY: optional, 70+ AV engines, free tier: 4 req/min, 500/day

nodes.languageNotes: Entry commands: 'node ~/guardog/src/index.js analyze <package> [npm|pypi]', 'node ~/guardog/src/index.js batch <packages.json>', 'node ~/guardog/src/index.js test'. Claude Code skill: /guardog <package> [npm|pypi]. References companion gstack-cso skill for code-level review (OWASP Top 10 + STRIDE).

nodes.title: Guard-Dog Operations Manifest
nodes.summary: Operational manifest describing guard-dog security operations structure. Defines log/data/report/archive directory layout, retention policies (scans 90d, alerts 365d, install-history 365d, dependency-changes 365d, reports 730d, critical-incidents 1825d), key files (.logindex.json, logs schema, vulnerability schema), daily operations workflow, and jq query examples for vulnerability lookups.

directories.data: vulnerabilities master database, remediation tracking, baselines

nodes.languageNotes: Log format schema files: .logindex.json (format and retention), logs/install-history/schema.json (audit structure), data/vulnerabilities/schema.json (vulnerability tracking). Includes jq query examples for common operations: find vulnerabilities by package, get critical issues from last 7 days, list monthly installations.

nodes.title: Environment Configuration Template
nodes.summary: Template for environment variables. Defines optional and recommended API keys: VIRUSTOTAL_API_KEY (highly recommended, free tier sufficient), TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN and TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID (optional, sends BARK alerts), GITHUB_API_TOKEN (optional, increases GitHub rate limits). Includes signup links and usage notes.

TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN.description: sends message when BARK package detected

GITHUB_API_TOKEN.description: increases rate limits for reputation checks

nodes.languageNotes: Template file for copying to .env. Only VIRUSTOTAL_API_KEY is needed for basic functionality. Telegram integration requires both TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN and TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID for BARK alert notifications.

nodes.title: Git Ignore Rules
nodes.summary: Git ignore patterns for guard-dog repository. Excludes: node_modules and package-lock.json (dependencies), .env files (secrets), logs, npm-debug.log, OS files (.DS_Store, Thumbs.db), IDE configs (.vscode, .idea), test coverage, build outputs (dist, build), guardog runtime data (data, logs, archive), and internal documentation (IMPLEMENTATION.md, OPERATIONS.md, etc.).
nodes.languageNotes: Guardog runtime data directories (data/, logs/, archive/) are version-control excluded. Internal workspace automation scripts and documentation are not shipped in distribution.

nodes.title: NPM Publish Ignore Rules
nodes.summary: NPM publish ignore patterns. Excludes runtime state (.env files, data/, logs/, archive/, reports/), development files (node_modules, debug logs, OS/IDE files), test coverage, internal workspace automation (bin/ scripts for mission-control, logging setup, vulnerability sync, threat-intel), and internal documentation (CLAUDE.md, CONTEXT.md, project/implementation docs).
nodes.languageNotes: Stricter than .gitignore to ensure public npm distribution contains only distributable code and configuration. Excludes workspace-specific automation, internal documentation, and runtime state.

nodes.title: Security Policy
nodes.summary: Security policy for guardog project. Covers vulnerability reporting procedures, supported versions (pre-1.1 public release, fixes on default branch first), and secret handling guidelines (do not include API keys, .env files, scan cache, or logs in reports).

metadata.fixPriority: default branch first, then released from latest tagged version
metadata.secretHandling: Do not include API keys, tokens, .env, scan cache, or runtime logs

nodes.languageNotes: Emphasizes private disclosure for vulnerabilities. Requests affected package name, version, reproduction steps, and relevant logs/scan output. Fallback: minimal public issue requesting private security contact without exploit details.

nodes.title: Guardog Claude Code Skill
nodes.summary: Claude Code skill definition for guardog. Provides /guardog command to scan npm or PyPI packages for security threats. Performs multi-layer checks: CVE lookup (Google OSV), package reputation (npm/PyPI/GitHub), malicious code patterns (30+), optional VirusTotal (70+ AV engines). Returns verdicts: SILENT (safe), WHINE (suspicious), BARK (dangerous). Suggests companion /gstack-cso for code-level OWASP/STRIDE review on BARK/WHINE results.

checksPerformed: VirusTotal-scan (70+ AV engines, if API key configured)

nodes.languageNotes: Skill file uses fallback path discovery: tries ~/guardog/ first, then searches for index.js via 'find ~ -name index.js -path '*/guardog/src/*''. Recommends running /gstack-cso on affected code for BARK or WHINE verdicts.

nodes.title: Legacy Guardog Installer
nodes.summary: Bash installation script for guardog. Notes recommended cross-platform path (npm install -g github:josephtandle/guardog). Installs dependencies, creates data directory, installs Claude Code skill, optionally installs git pre-commit hook, prompts for VirusTotal API key, runs Node.js setup wizard. Provides installation feedback and usage examples.
nodes.languageNotes: Legacy installer; README recommends npm-based installation. Asks user permission for optional features (git hook, VirusTotal key). Saves VirusTotal key to .env in install directory. Creates .claude/skills directory symlink for Claude Code skill integration.
